summary: Static-analysis verification of Expo mobile app fixes for (1) FAB blocking touches and (2) SafeArea overlap. All user-specified surgical changes verified present and correct. Backend regression smoke test passed for all 4 endpoints.

verification_results.FloatingAIButton.js: PASS — Only TouchableOpacity with position:absolute, right:20, bottom:90, width:56, height:56, zIndex:10. No screen-blocking wrapper. testID='floating-ai-button' present.
verification_results.SafeScreen.js: PASS — Uses SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context, default edges=['top','bottom'].
verification_results.App.js withFAB pointerEvents: PASS — Wrapping View has pointerEvents='box-none' (line 55), allowing touches to pass through to inner screen except FAB area.
verification_results.App.js SafeAreaProvider: PASS — Imported from react-native-safe-area-context (line 3), wraps NavigationContainer (lines 147-155).
verification_results.16 screens use SafeScreen: PASS — All 16 v2 screens (HomeScreen, BhaktiScreen, KundliScreen, PanchangScreen, ProfileScreen, AIChatScreen, DeityDetailScreen, ContentDetailScreen, KathasScreen, KathaDetailScreen, GranthListScreen, GranthChaptersScreen, GranthVersesScreen, VedasPuranasScreen, VedaSuktasScreen, PuranaDetailScreen) use <SafeScreen> wrapper (DeityDetailScreen and ContentDetailScreen have 2 occurrences due to loading/error states).

critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and surgical. The fixes match user requirements exactly.
Note: Tab root screens get extra paddingBottom (100) to clear the 64px tab bar + FAB at bottom 90 — appropriate buffer.
Note: Detail screens (no FAB, just back nav) use paddingBottom 80, also acceptable since they are pushed via stack navigator over the tab bar.
test_credentials: Not used — no auth flows tested in this iteration
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cannot run Expo in container (per main agent instruction). All verification done via static file inspection + grep + ESLint + backend curl. Two surgical fixes (pointerEvents='box-none' on withFAB wrapping View in App.js line 55, and SafeScreen default edges=['top','bottom']) are correctly in place. All 16 v2 screens consistently wrap content in <SafeScreen> and ScrollViews carry paddingBottom>=80. Backend endpoints all respond 200.
rca of the issue: User reported: (1) inner screen buttons unresponsive due to a parent View intercepting taps — fixed by adding pointerEvents='box-none' to the View wrapping (Component + FloatingAIButton) inside withFAB HOC. (2) Status bar / Android nav bar overlapping content — fixed by SafeScreen using SafeAreaView with edges=['top','bottom'] from react-native-safe-area-context, plus SafeAreaProvider at root. Both root causes addressed surgically; no regressions detected.
